entries.speaker: Thin-Browed Student
entries.en: Finally, I'm finished. Now I can go to[n]Shibuya with my boyfriend.

entries.en: Oh, be careful. I heard there's[n]been people causing all sorts[n]of weird incidents lately.

entries.speaker: Thin-Browed Student
entries.en: Oh, that thing when people flip out[n]and go berserk out of nowhere? I'm[n]sure the police can handle it.

entries.en: Yeah, let's not worry about it.[n]Maybe I'll stop by somewhere[n]fun on the way home, too.

entries.en: Did you see that second-year on the[n]volleyball team? He must've taken[n]a spike in the face.

entries.en: Oh, Mishima, right? He's a real[n]slowpoke, so I'm not surprised.

entries.speaker: Assertive Volleyball Player
entries.en: It's frustrating to watch. He's not getting[n]much better, even with Mr. Kamoshida's[n]coaching.

entries.speaker: Glaring Third-Year
